detail.en: A compact aft passenger shelter follows the visitor’s archival depiction and model image. Its shortened, narrower canvas roof arches over a seated bay; the four stanchions land on the aft deck. Length, breadth and rise are editable reconstructions, not measurements from a surviving cabin.
detail.mt: Tinda żgħira għall-passiġġieri fuq wara ssegwi x-xbieha storika u l-mudell tal-viżitatur. Saqaf tal-kanvas iqsar u idjaq jitgħawweġ fuq il-bankijiet; erba’ appoġġi joqogħdu fuq it-tamburett ta’ wara. It-tul, il-wisa’ u l-għoli huma stimi li jistgħu jinbidlu, mhux qisien ta’ kabina li għadha teżisti.

citations.locator: pp. 130, 132–133 · sprit rig and stern passenger cabin; exact fitting geometry reconstructed from visitor images

detail.en: The reconstructed rig separates mast hoops and luff lacing, the sprit heel strop, halyard blocks with bored housings and separate sheaves, mainsheet, jib sheet, forestay and shrouds. Routes follow the visitor’s reference images; exact reeving, rope sizes and block dimensions remain inferred. Muscat documents several rigging phases; this is one sprit-rig teaching arrangement.
detail.mt: L-armar rikostruwit juri ċrieki mal-arblu, irbit tal-qlugħ, l-irbit tal-lasta, blokki mtaqqbin b’taljoli separati, ħbula tal-qlugħ u appoġġi tal-arblu. Il-mogħdijiet isegwu r-ritratti tal-viżitatur; id-dijametri u l-qisien huma stimi. Muscat jiddokumenta diversi fażijiet tal-armar; dan huwa eżempju wieħed għat-tagħlim.

citations.locator: pp. 130, 132–133 · sprit rig and stern passenger cabin; exact fitting geometry reconstructed from visitor images

detail.en: The four-sided tarkija clears the smaller aft shelter. Its luff attaches to mast hoops and the peak is supported by the diagonal sprit. Cloth constraints preserve the cabin clearance under wind. Sail dimensions and the illustrated control arrangement remain reconstructed.
detail.mt: It-tarkija b’erba’ naħat tħalli spazju fuq it-tinda iżgħar ta’ wara. Il-qlugħ jintrabat maċ-ċrieki tal-arblu u mal-lasta djagonali. Il-moviment tad-drapp iżomm spazju fuq it-tinda. Il-qisien u l-armar illustrat huma rikostruwiti.

citations.locator: pp. 130, 132–133 · sprit rig and stern passenger cabin; exact fitting geometry reconstructed from visitor images

detail.en: A vertical steering assembly closely follows the upright Maltese stern shown in the supplied model image. The stock axis is set from the actual stern geometry with hinge clearance, rather than an arbitrary aft offset. Blade, cheeks, bored stock seats, bolts and tiller remain separate pieces. The visitor’s foreign examples have raked arrangements; this model does not treat that rake as Maltese evidence.
detail.mt: L-assemblaġġ vertikali tat-tmun joqgħod qrib il-poppa wieqfa murija fil-mudell mogħti. L-assi jiġi kkalkulat mill-poppa b’vojt għaċ-ċappetti. Ix-xafra, il-ġnub, is-sokits imtaqqbin, il-boltijiet u l-laċċ huma biċċiet separati. L-eżempji barranin tal-viżitatur għandhom poppa mmejla; dik il-forma mhix attribwita lil Malta.

reconstruction.en: An original educational reconstruction using the public description of Antonio Montesanto’s 2013 Cariati museum model, catalogue 1800178462. It is not a scan or a measured replica. Full-scale dimensions, hull curves, rig proportions and finishes are illustrative. Muscat’s visiting Italian gozzi are a separate historical relationship. The waterline is illustrative.
reconstruction.mt: Rikostruzzjoni edukattiva oriġinali mid-deskrizzjoni pubblika tal-mudell ta’ Antonio Montesanto tal-2013 fil-mużew ta’ Cariati, katalogu 1800178462. Mhix skan jew replika mkejla. Il-qisien, il-kurvi, l-armar u l-kuluri huma illustrattivi. Il-gozzi Taljani msemmija minn Muscat huma relazzjoni storika separata. Il-linja tal-ilma hija illustrattiva.

terminologyNote.en: Maltese part names here are comparison labels, not recorded Italian terminology. Maltese craft lessons describe the Maltese tradition; timber species and treatments are not established for this gozzo.

reconstruction.en: A composite educational racing hull. The Paċenzja photograph reproduced by Serracino shows an historical tal-midalji silhouette; the federation identifies today’s four-rower class. Dimensions, station lines, frame shapes, scantlings and rowing positions are illustrative, not class-rule measurements or a replica of Paċenzja. The 1929 photograph is a specimen record, not an invention date. No sail, canopy or steering rudder is inferred from the photograph. The waterline and paint shades are illustrative.
reconstruction.mt: Buq kompost edukattiv tat-tlielaq. Ir-ritratt ta’ Paċenzja riprodott minn Serracino juri siluwett storiku tal-midalji; il-federazzjoni tidentifika l-klassi tal-lum b’erba’ qaddiefa. Il-qisien, il-kurvi, il-majjieri, il-ħxuna u l-pożizzjonijiet tal-qdif huma illustrattivi, mhux kejl tar-regolamenti jew replika ta’ Paċenzja. Ir-ritratt tal-1929 huwa rekord ta’ eżemplar, mhux data tal-invenzjoni. Ma ġiex preżunt qlugħ, tinda jew tmun mir-ritratt. Il-linja tal-ilma u l-ilwien huma illustrattivi.

detail.en: Paired bow eyes express recorded protective beliefs and hopes for a safe return. Brows, painted outlines and iris treatment vary between boats. The selector presents original studies supported by photographs or published descriptions. Muscat’s Horus naming and other ancient-origin interpretations remain attributed; uninterrupted continuity from antiquity is not established. L-isem Horus ta’ Muscat u interpretazzjonijiet oħra tal-oriġini antika jibqgħu attribwiti; kontinwità mill-antik mhix ippruvata. Il-mudell attwali għandu korp żgħir f’riljiev, tebqet il-għajn, iris, pupilla u ħuġbejn skolpit. In-naħa ta’ wara ssegwi l-buq; il-post u d-dimensjonijiet jibqgħu approssimattivi.
